Wielded by Guardian Scouts, this spear has a high piercing power and is a testament to the Sheikah's high level of technology. the spearhead appears only when brandished.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 10 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Spear}} Guardian Spears are wielded by [[Guardian Scout II|Guardian Scouts II]] inside "A Minor Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s, and they are dropped upon their defeat. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. When brandished, Guardian Spears produce a glowing blue spearhead. The spearhead disappears when resting upon [[Link]]'s back. They have a high piercing power due to being made with [[Sheikah]] [[Ancient Technology]]. Being made of Ancient Technology, Guardian Spears deal extra damage to [[Enemy]] Guardians. Guardian Spears are not magnetic, so they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]], nor can they be attracted by the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They are also not flammable, which means they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. When dropped into a body of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], Guardian Spears will float upon its surface. Guardian Spears are part of the equipment archetype known as [[Guardian Gear]], which includes all Weapons utilized by [[Guardian Scout]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_013" |Life = 20 |Power = 10 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.3 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 18 |BuyingPrice = 39 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Guardian Spear Inactive Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Inactive Guardian Spear File:AoC Guardian Spear Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Guardian Spear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Ancient Weapon * Guardian Gear * Guardian Spear+ * Guardian Spear++ }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Ancient Weapons, Guardian Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
